title: Don’t Tread On Me
caption: •Don’t Tread On Me (V)
game_text:
USED: Use 1 Force to ▼ an Effect that deploys for free on table (or your side of table) and is always {alter}.
STARTING: When drawing your starting hand, draw up to 12 cards instead of 8. Place this Interrupt in Reserve Deck.

notes: Group: Everything Else. Bottom-half slip; banner USED OR STARTING INTERRUPT (letter-spaced). Slip heading and caption print '•' (unique); the printed SE card is unrestricted and has no dot — title kept as printed ('Don’t Tread On Me'), caption as the slip prints it (same practice as vs8/29, vs10/02). ▼ inline; '{alter}' = the red circle-slash A before the final period of the USED line (stub expands it to 'Immune to Alter' and ▼ to 'Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'). USED:/STARTING: lines separated by \n. Credits under the text box: 'Original concept by Steven Lewis' / 'PC Volunteer Award 2008'. CHANGES vs printed card: text replaced (printed: 'USED: Add 1 to your just-drawn weapon destiny. STARTING: If you have deployed a battleground, deploy Ultimatum, Scrambled Transmission and/or Do, Or Do Not from Reserve Deck. Place Interrupt in Reserve Deck.'). LORE: curly apostrophe Jabba’s (wiki straight); printed lore starts flush left with NO first-line indent (scan and V0 745 remake) → lore_indent 0. Copyright SE 1998 legible on V0-L-donttreadonme.gif. Modern: V0-L-donttreadonme.gif (745, Virtual Set 0 remake, same art) used; VB1-L-donttreadonme-pre.gif (350, Virtual Block 1) also downloaded.
